zones.title: Receive
zones.body: One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

zones.title: Load state
zones.body: The session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

zones.title: Reason
zones.body: PrepareTurn rebuilds the system prompt from facts and applies the yes/no gates. The agent has three tools, Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

zones.title: Guard
zones.body: Code decides: no booking claim without a code, caller-request rule, gate advance, handover line. Handoff builds the Refer-To here.

zones.title: Respond
zones.body: Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

panels.title: AR-02 Dialogue turn
panels.body: The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

panels.title: Tools
panels.body: FindDealers, FindSlots, BookAppointment. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.
